title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: River Indie User Manual | Information to the Owner Safety and Vehicle Damage Warning River Mobility cares about your safety and the safety of those around you. This manual provides many safety procedures and instructions. This information is meant to forewarn you about potential hazards to you and others, as well as your vehicle. Safety messages found on the vehicle and in this manual describe these hazards and what to do to avoid or reduce the risk of injury. Failing to follow safety warnings and instructions may lead to serious injury or death. This is the safety alert symbol. This symbol precedes the signal words DANGER, WARNING and CAUTION. Safety instructions following this symbol have to be observed to avoid possible injury or death. DANGER DANGER indicates a hazardous situation which, if not avoided, will result in death or serious injury. WARNING WARNING indicates a hazardous situation which, if not avoided, may result in death or serious injury. CAUTION CAUTION indicates a hazardous situation which, if not avoided, could result in minor or moderate injury. NOTICE NOTICE indicates a situation which, if not avoided, could result in vehicle loss or damage. 5 5

title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: River Indie User Manual | Getting Started What is an Electric Scooter? An electric scooter such as the Indie is driven by a motor which is powered by a rechargeable battery, while traditional vehicles are powered by an internal combustion engine which runs by burning fossil fuels. Consequently, electric scooters are eco-friendly as they do not require fuel and do not emit exhaust gases. Characteristics of Indie 1. Indie runs on energy stored in the lithium-ion battery pack which powers the motor. It is more efficient in traffic since the motor does not idle like an engine and has fewer moving parts. The battery pack also powers auxiliary units such as the lamps, instrument cluster and other connected peripherals. 2. Indie is charged using a provided charger which can be plugged into a residential 16A power socket. This allows you to charge at home without having to refuel at a petrol station. You can charge it like any other portable electronic device such as a mobile phone. 3. Indie is equipped with regenerative braking. This aids in partially recharging the batteries while decelerating or riding downhill. This minimizes energy loss and increases efficiency and range. 9 9

title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: River Indie User Manual | Charging the Indie To charge the Indie’s battery, please follow the guide below. Charger Port on the vehicle Charger Port Glovebox The charger port is located under the charger lid on the left side of the glovebox. To access the same, you will need to: 1. Park the vehicle and turn-OFF the key. 2. Open the lid of the glove box to access the charger lid knob inside. Pull the knob in order to open the charger lid. Charger Lid Knob WARNING • Do not leave the charger lid open while parked in the rain. • Do not leave the charger lid open while washing the vehicle. CAUTION • Please ensure that the Indie is free from obstructions near the charger lid. Else, it might result in damage to the charger lid. • Please ensure that the charger lid is only opened for charging the Indie. • At all other points of time, while riding and parking the Indie, please ensure that the charger lid remains closed. 29 29

title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: River Indie User Manual | Charging the Indie Note: • Charging takes place only when the vehicle is in OFF/Lock condition. • The latching sound indicates that the charger gun is locked on to the vehicle when the vehicle is in OFF/Lock condition. The charger gun is unlocked when you turn-ON the vehicle. • During charging, the vehicle will be immobilised. • You may have to wait up to 60 seconds before the Indie starts charging. • You may have to wait up to 60 seconds for the estimated charging time to be provided. WARNING • Do not attempt to plug the charger gun into the charger inlet by force. If you are unable to insert the charger gun onto the vehicle, please contact River Mobility or an authorised service centre. • Charge the vehicle only by using the charger provided by River Mobility. • Do not handle the charger with wet hands. • Do not submerge the charger in water. • Do not charge the

title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: Mobility. • Do not handle the charger with wet hands. • Do not submerge the charger in water. • Do not charge the vehicle if the parked location is water logged. • Do not wash the vehicle while it is being charged. Stopping/Unplugging the charger To stop charging, please follow these steps: 1. Insert the key into the lockset and turn it ON. 2. You should hear a click and the charger will turn off and disengage. 3. Unplug the charger gun from the vehicle. 4. Disconnect the PRCD plug from the wall socket. 5. Store the charger in a dry and safe location. WARNING • Do not attempt to pull the charger gun by force. If you are unable to remove the charger gun from the vehicle, please contact River Mobility or an authorised service centre. 33 33

title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: River Indie User Manual | Loading & Storage Glovebox • The 12 litre glovebox in the front comes in handy to store your essentials. • To unlock it, insert the key into the glovebox lock and rotate it clockwise. • To lock it, close the glovebox lid and rotate the key counter-clockwise. • The glovebox can carry up to 3kg. NOTICE Please note that any loading on the glovebox lid while it is open may impact its operation. The glovebox is not fully sealed against water or dust. Do not store phones, wallets, Underseat Storage or moisture-sensitive items in the glovebox, especially during rain or washing. Always close the glovebox securely before every ride. Handle the glovebox key with care to avoid damaging the lock mechanism. • The 43 litre storage under the seat helps you to store your essentials or even two helmets. • To unlock it, insert the key into the seat lock located on the rear left side of the

title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: to store your essentials or even two helmets. • To unlock it, insert the key into the seat lock located on the rear left side of the scooter and rotate it clockwise. Pull the seat up after a click sound is heard. • To lock it, push the seat back down and press it. A click sound will be heard when the seat is locked. • The storage box can carry up to 5kg. 37 39

title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: River Indie User Manual | Loading & Storage Bag Hook • The bag hook in front of the seat helps you to carry your shopping bags. • To operate it, rotate the hook out from its position, and open the top portion to hang your bags. • The bag hook can carry up to 3kg. Floorboard The floorboard of the Indie can carry up to 20kg of load. This includes the payload as well as the weight of any installed accessory. 38 42

title: river_indie_gen1_owners_manual
text: River Indie User Manual | Loading & Storage Pannier Stay (optional) The pannier stays* (if equipped) on either side of the Indie can carry up to 5kg. This includes the payload as well as the weight of any installed accessory. Loading limits The total load limit of the vehicle is defined in the Gross Vehicle Weight. Depending on the payload carried, the performance of the vehicle such as top speed, acceleration and range may be impacted. WARNING • Loading the vehicle beyond the specified load limit may lead to instability of the vehicle while riding. • Loading the vehicle beyond the specified load limit may cause damage. This may void warranty coverage of the vehicle. • Ensure that the cargo attached to the bag hook does not interfere with the movement of your feet. • Do not keep valuable items inside the storage spaces when leaving the vehicle unattended. 39 43
